imageUrls.title: Image urls
imageUrls.description: One image url per line: jpeg, png, webp, gif, bmp, tiff or heic. Each picture is read once and recognized inside the actor, so no key and no OCR service is needed. A line that is not an http url, a repeat and a line beyond maxImages come back as their own free row with the reason.

maxImages.title: Max images
maxImages.description: The list is cut here and the rest comes back free with status NOT_CHECKED_LIMIT. 0 means the default of 10, and the summary reports the number actually applied.

languages.title: OCR languages
languages.description: Language packs that ship inside the actor. More than one slows recognition, so ask only for the ones your pictures really use.

includeWordBoxes.title: Include word boxes
includeWordBoxes.description: Every word with its x, y, width, height and confidence. Turn it off when only the plain text is needed: rows get much smaller.

maxPixels.title: Max pixels
maxPixels.description: A picture larger than this is scaled down before recognition and the row says so in scaled. Keeps a 200 megapixel phone panorama from running the container out of memory.
